meta.name: update-nanoclaw
meta.description: Efficiently bring upstream NanoClaw updates into a customized install, with preview, selective cherry-pick, and low token usage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预览上游更新,挑选合入定制安装
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果维护着定制版NanoClaw,想便捷同步官方更新
copy.tagline_en: Preview upstream updates and cherry-pick them into your customized install
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain a customized NanoClaw and want to sync official updates

howto.what: 运行 /update-nanoclaw 后,Claude 会把上游 NanoClaw 更新合入你本地定制的安装:先备份和预览变更,再按你的选择合并、挑选提交或变基,解决冲突并运行构建与测试,最后提示破坏性变更。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中发出 /update-nanoclaw 命令时触发,用于把上游 NanoClaw 更新合入本地定制安装。

say.text: 运行 /update-nanoclaw,把上游更新合进来。
say.note: Claude 会先检查工作区,脏则停止,否则备份并预览变更。

say.text: 用 /update-nanoclaw 只挑选几个上游提交,不要全量合并。
运行 /update-nanoclaw,改用 rebase 模式。
say.note: Claude 会线性重放本地提交,冲突逐个处理。

howto.what_en: Running /update-nanoclaw makes Claude fetch upstream NanoClaw changes, back up your install, preview the diff, then merge, cherry-pick, or rebase commits, resolve conflicts, run build/test, and flag breaking changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /update-nanoclaw in Claude Code, to bring upstream NanoClaw updates into your customized install.

say_en.text: Run /update-nanoclaw to pull in upstream updates.
say_en.note: Claude checks the workspace, backs up, and previews changes.

say_en.text: Use /update-nanoclaw to cherry-pick only a few upstream commits.
say_en.note: Claude lists commits and applies only the ones you pick.
Claude replays commits on upstream, resolving conflicts.
